newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool mart unsetled by pace of price changes.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool mart unsetled by pace of price changes.

text.p: Price rises in Australia and New Zealand unsettled the UK wool processing industry with topmakers finding it hard to adjust their upward quotes to the pace of the rally.
Some market participants felt a period of consolidation was needed to create a more stable basis for doing business.

An easing in Australia on Thursday was seen confined to broader Merino types. Fine wools continue to get dearer and the market is responding to tight supply, a situation likely to persist for about six weeks until new season wool is offered in substantial volume.

The industry is busy locally, especially in the Merino combing sector, with deliveries going out well. Despite higher prices, inquiry is better and some new business is being booked. - - London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
